original: What is true is already so. Owning up to it doesn't make it worse. Not being open about it doesn't make it go away.
traduccion: Lo que es verdad ya es así. Reconocerlo no lo empeora. No abrirse a eso no hace que desaparezca.

evidencia.fragmento:
stupid  or  imperfect.
What  is  true  is  already  so.  Owning  up  to  it  doesn't make  it  worse
